# Doit Then 1.0.29
- Added One-way and Two-way options to Calendar Mirror. - Simplified Calendar Mirror setup and calendar selection. - Added customizable Quick Add global keyboard shortcuts with live recording. - Added Reset to restore the default Control-Command-A shortcut. - Improved Escape dismissal for the up-to-date notification.
Two-way Calendar Mirror is optional. Reverse changes apply only to supported managed events. Recurring events and deletions remain source-controlled.
